title: Engineering Growth, AI, and Modern Rails Practices — ChicagoRuby Meetup & PayPal
description:
At ChicagoRuby April 2026 speakers covered topics such as advancing to staff-level engineering, challenges in entering tech, maintaining and upgrading Rails applications, and best practices for running reliable production systems. A major focus was also on how to use AI effectively while preserving code quality and developer craftsmanship.

Speakers:
🎙 Joel Hawksley  — Beyond Senior: Consider the Staff Path
Joel is a Staff Software Engineer at GitHub, working on the health of the GitHub.com Rails monolith. You’re at senior, but you’re hungry for more. What’s next?
He:
• Explored what the Staff Engineer role actually means
• Helped you decide if the staff path might be right for your career

🎙 Tyler Ewing — Your Business Workflows Are Invisible But They Shouldn’t Be
Tyler runs his own shop and created Ductwork, a Ruby workflow framework.
In that talk, Tyler:
• Live-refactored a realistic onboarding workflow
• Turned tangled logic into a clear, readable pipeline
• Showed how explicit workflows improve debugging and observability
